hooks.name: pre_trade_validation
hooks.description: Validate all trade requirements before order placement

checks.name: market_hours_check
checks.rule: if current_time not between 10:00-15:00 Dubai time, BLOCK

checks.name: symbol_approval_check
checks.rule: if symbol not in [ENBD, ADIB, Emaar, DP World], BLOCK

checks.name: confidence_alert_check
checks.rule: if confidence between 0.55-0.75, ALERT user (5 min timeout)

checks.name: weekly_loss_limit_check
checks.rule: if (week_loss + risk_amount) > 15.00 USD, BLOCK and ALERT

checks.name: position_size_check
checks.rule: validate position size matches Kelly Criterion calculation

hooks.name: post_trade_logging
hooks.description: Log all executed trades to Supabase and notify system

actions.name: close_all_positions
actions.rule: At market close (15:05 Dubai), close ALL open positions

actions.name: check_daily_loss_limit
actions.rule: if daily_loss >= 5.00 USD, prevent trading tomorrow

actions.name: reset_trade_counter
actions.action: Reset daily trade count to 0 for next day

hooks.name: weekly_strategy_review
hooks.description: Weekly performance analysis and strategy adjustment

actions.name: check_weekly_loss_limit
actions.rule: if weekly_loss >= 15.00 USD, block all trading next week

actions.name: update_position_sizes
actions.rule: Based on win rate, adjust next week's position sizes

actions.name: signal_accuracy_tracking
actions.action: Calculate win rate by signal type (RSI, MACD, Volume, MeanRev)

hooks.name: halt_monitoring
hooks.description: Check for trading halts before market open

actions.name: fetch_halt_list
actions.action: Check if any approved symbols [ENBD, ADIB, Emaar, DP World] are halted

actions.name: block_halted_symbols
actions.rule: if symbol in halt list, BLOCK trades for that symbol today
actions.action: UPDATE approved_symbols to exclude halted tickers

hooks.name: emergency_stop_loss
hooks.description: Automatic stop-loss enforcement on all open positions

checks.name: check_position_stops
checks.rule: Every 10 seconds, check if any position hit stop loss price
checks.action: if yes, SELL immediately at market price

checks.name: check_position_targets
checks.rule: Every 10 seconds, check if any position hit take profit price
checks.action: if yes, SELL immediately at market price

checks.name: daily_loss_limit_emergency
checks.action: CLOSE ALL positions immediately, STOP trading
